cards.name: Venonat
cards.description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Tyrogue
cards.description: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

cards.name: Hitmontop
cards.description: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.

cards.name: Landorus
cards.description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.description: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.description: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

cards.name: Stakataka
cards.description: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.description: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

cards.name: Sharpedo
cards.description: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

cards.name: Greninja
cards.description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.description: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett
cards.description: Although it's powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn't allow itself to be seen very often.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.description: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it's not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.description: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.description: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

cards.name: Togetic
cards.description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.description: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

cards.name: Spritzee
cards.description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

cards.name: Aromatisse
cards.description: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.description: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn't need to know.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.description: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.description: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.description: It would claim another Pokémon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

cards.name: Happiny
cards.description: Usually it's a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.

cards.name: Chatot
cards.description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.description: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.

cards.name: Kartana
cards.description: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.description: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.description: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.description: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

cards.name: Litten
cards.description: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

cards.name: Litten
cards.description: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

cards.name: Torracat
cards.description: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.

cards.name: Incineroar
cards.description: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.

cards.name: Blacephalon
cards.description: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.description: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.description: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.description: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.description: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

cards.name: Tentacool
cards.description: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

cards.name: Tentacruel
cards.description: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.

cards.name: Slowbro
cards.description: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.description: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It's especially fond of Wishiwashi.

cards.name: Krabby
cards.description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

cards.name: Kingler
cards.description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.description: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Kyurem
cards.description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Frogadier
cards.description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

cards.name: Pyukumuku
cards.description: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

cards.name: Charjabug
cards.description: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!

cards.name: Vikavolt
cards.description: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Zeraora
cards.description: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.description: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

cards.name: Arbok
cards.description: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.description: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.

cards.name: Hypno
cards.description: In Alola, Komala is Hypno's main target. It rarely harms people.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

cards.name: Mew
cards.description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.description: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.description: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.description: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

cards.name: Geodude
cards.description: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

cards.name: Graveler
cards.description: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.description: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Wooper
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

cards.name: Quagsire
cards.description: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
